recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future terminology decision changes the Duration units value set.
issue_request: FHIR-15868 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request asking to include minutes ('min') in the Duration value set because minutes are common duration units.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records vote approval and a comment pointing to svn revision 14080. Migrated git commit 59f2e1dafd8e9ebcac7b54ae31ab1dcd51da52af, "GF#15868 - add minutes to Duration value set", added UCUM code min with display minutes to source/datatypes/valueset-duration-units.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Duration as an active datatype, and source/datatypes/duration.xml binds DurationUnits to valueset-duration-units, so the checked value set source is in current FHIR build scope. Later git history changed surrounding value set metadata but did not remove the min concept. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The authoritative value set source already contains code min with display minutes in the UCUM include for duration units.
